product_overview: CRM web for commercial teams to manage leads, WhatsApp-centric messaging, tasks, calls and campaigns with role-and-country scoped visibility and an executive KPI dashboard.
core_goals: Convert conversations into leads and move leads through the sales pipeline to closure.
Provide agents with a single workspace to manage messages, tasks and calls per lead.
Give admins and superadmins executive visibility via KPI dashboard and operational alerts.
Maintain traceability of commercial actions through history and audit logs.

features.name: Authentication and role-aware session
features.description: Users sign in and receive a role-aware session that controls access and visibility across the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> Redirect to /dashboard -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> Receive feedback on invalid credentials

features.name: Dashboard (executive view and alerts)
features.description: Executive dashboard surface KPIs, SLA indicators and operational alerts, and lets users filter and act on high-level signals.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> See KPI cards and operational alerts -> Apply country filter -> See updated KPI cards
Navigate to /dashboard -> See list of alerts -> Select an alert to inspect context -> Navigate to /dashboard/leads to review related leads

features.name: Lead lifecycle workflow
features.description: Create and manage leads through defined states, view their integrated workspace (messages/tasks/calls) and apply business rules to close leads.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/leads -> Create manual lead with country and phone -> See new lead in list with initial state
Navigate to /dashboard/leads -> Filter and sort leads -> Select a lead from the list -> Change lead status and register a business action -> See lead status history updated
Navigate to /dashboard/leads -> Attempt to mark lead as venta without a registered call -> Receive validation feedback preventing closure

features.name: Messaging and conversation management
features.description: Manage WhatsApp-linked conversations: browse inbox, view message threads, compose/send messages and apply approved templates; link conversations to leads.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/mensajes -> Select a conversation from list -> See message thread and history
Navigate to /dashboard/mensajes -> Select a conversation -> Write message in composer -> Send message using Enter -> See message appended to thread
Navigate to /dashboard/mensajes -> Select a conversation -> Apply approved template to message composer -> Send templated message -> See templated message in thread
Navigate to /dashboard/mensajes -> Select a conversation -> Use CTA to open linked lead -> Navigate to /dashboard/leads

features.name: Task operations and follow-up control
features.description: Create and manage tasks tied to leads, filter by status and schedule window, update task status and review change history to enforce follow-up discipline.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/tareas -> Filter tasks by status and schedule window -> See filtered task list
Navigate to /dashboard/tareas -> Select task and update status to completada -> See task status history updated

Navigate to /dashboard/tareas -> Create a new task for a lead -> Attempt to create a duplicate pending task of the same type for the same lead -> Receive validation feedback preventing duplicate pending tasks

features.name: Calls registration and outcomes
features.description: Record call attempts tied to leads, submit post-call results and notes, and use call outcomes to enable downstream sales actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/llamadas -> Browse call list and select a call -> See call details and linked lead
Navigate to /dashboard/llamadas -> Select a call -> Submit post-call result and notes (e.g., interesado or no_contesta) -> See updated result badge and call history
Navigate to /dashboard/llamadas -> Submit call result venta for a lead -> Navigate to /dashboard/leads -> Close lead as venta when rules are satisfied

features.name: Campaign management overview
features.description: Search, filter and inspect campaign records, review per-recipient logs, and create campaign drafts for later execution.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/campanas -> Search and filter campaigns -> See filtered campaign list
Navigate to /dashboard/campanas -> Select a campaign to inspect details and logs -> Review campaign logs and recipient statuses
Navigate to /dashboard/campanas -> Create a new campaign draft -> See new draft in campaign list

features.name: Configuration and governance
features.description: Manage system configuration by country, user assignments, message templates and automation parameters, and review audit summaries for governance.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/configuracion -> Create or edit a country entry -> See updated country list
Navigate to /dashboard/configuracion -> Update user role or country assignment -> See assignment reflected in user list
Navigate to /dashboard/configuracion -> Edit template settings and automation parameters -> Save changes and see configuration summary
Navigate to /dashboard/configuracion -> Trigger automation run -> Review automation run summary and audit entries

routes.description: Executive dashboard with KPI cards, filters, and operational alerts.
Lead lifecycle management with integrated workspace (messages/tasks/calls).
Conversation inbox, message thread, templates, and send actions.
Task management and status tracking by lead.
Calls history and post-call result workflow.
Campaign list, campaign detail, and campaign creation flow.
Roles, countries, user assignments, templates, automation config, and audit.

known_limitations.issue: Database row-level security is intentionally deferred; visibility is enforced mainly at service layer.
known_limitations.impact: Requires careful regression checks for scope filtering and role isolation.

known_limitations.issue: WhatsApp calling is not supported in this Cloud API setup.
known_limitations.impact: Voice call flows remain manual/simulated in CRM context.
